author: iOSPhotoUser99
raw_statement: The search functionality used to be magic, now it's incredibly frustrating. I search for 'dog in park' and get random screenshots of texts. Please fix the AI search, it's a huge downgrade.

author: memory_keeper22
raw_statement: I've been typing descriptions and captions manually on my iPhone for years so I can find old receipts and documents. As of the last update, searching those captions returns literally 0 results. All that time wasted.

author: FamilyGuy1980
raw_statement: Why can I no longer search for two people at once? I type 'Mom and Dad' and it just says 'No results found'. It used to pull up every picture of them together. Did they intentionally break the face grouping?

author: StudentLife44
raw_statement: Text recognition (OCR) inside images is totally broken. I take pictures of my lecture slides to search the text later. 'Photos' can't find anything anymore unless the text is massive and perfectly clear.

author: TravelBug_Sam
raw_statement: I just want to find all photos that are NOT in an album yet so I can organize them. There is literally no way to do this. A simple 'is:unorganized' filter would save me hours.

author: PixelConvert1
raw_statement: Every time I search for a location like 'Paris', it misses half the photos. I literally have the location tagged manually in the EXIF data but Google Photos ignores it and only uses its own AI guesses for location.
